title: Harden notification collection for NSE wakeups
body:
## Summary
- defer startup subscription setup for background notification cold starts so the collector subscribes before relay catch-up can emit updates
- force relay subscription setup during notification collection and give cold starts a longer first-notification window
- make group-plane same-spec updates idempotent so warm notification collection does not tear down healthy subscriptions unnecessarily

## Testing
- cargo test -p whitenoise background_notifications --lib
- cargo test -p whitenoise relay_control::groups::tests --lib
- cargo test -p whitenoise test_background_notification_initialization_defers_startup_subscriptions --lib

title: Add weekly Rust toolchain staleness issue check
body:
## Summary
- Add a GitHub Actions workflow that runs every Monday at 09:00 UTC and on manual dispatch.
- Compare the pinned `rust-toolchain.toml` version against the latest stable Rust release at runtime.
- Open a GitHub issue only when the pinned toolchain is stale, with exact-title deduplication to avoid duplicate spam.

## Testing
- Validated the new workflow with `actionlint` and YAML parsing.
- Verified the Python helper against mocked stale/current cases and a real latest-stable fetch.
- Ran `just precommit-quick` successfully.
